en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5547 - Ibn Abi Nasr Al-Bazanti narrated through his chain of transmission
that he was asked about a man who dies, leaving behind a family while owing a debt. Should his family be provided for from his wealth?

Imam (as) said: "If it is certain that the debt encompasses all of his wealth, then nothing should be spent on them. However, if it is not certain, then they should be provided for moderately from his wealth."
